overall: The AG found the Montague Board of Selectmen did not violate the Open Meeting Law, because its June 27 executive session discussion of the Police Chief's leave stayed within Purpose 1 and did not address his professional competence.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed professional competence in a June 27 executive session when it rescinded the Police Chief's administrative leave, which must occur in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Although the complainant's assumption is reasonable, the Board did not, in fact, discuss the Police Chiefs professional competence in making its decision.
